opportunities.title: [Bounty $7000] ttnn.xielu: exponent-reconstruction overflow produces values up to ±2.7e38 (and NaN) for x < -87.68
opportunities.summary: ## Summary `ttnn.xielu`'s negative-input branch calls an internal helper, `_sfpu_neg_exp_f32_`, to compute `exp(x)`. For any input `x < -87.68`, this helper's range-reduction logic breaks down and returns a essentially-random-magnitude garbage value instead of a number close to zero — including values as large as `2.7e38` (within a factor of ~1.25 of `FLT_MAX`) and, in some cases, `NaN`. This propagates directly into `ttnn.xielu`'s output: ``` ttnn.xielu(x=-90.0, alpha_p=..., alpha_n=0.8) -> 2.342323e+37 ``` ``` co
